headline: Apple tightens App Store rules against AI 'nudify' apps
summary: Apple updated its App Store rules to more explicitly ban so-called nudify apps that use AI to generate nonconsensual intimate images. The change follows criticism of Apple after X users used Grok earlier this year to create nonconsensual, sexualized deepfakes, including of minors.
